automaton.name: Clouds 3D
automaton.description: A 3D rule on the 26-neighborhood that condenses a random soup into cloud-like blobs. The displayed plane is the one where the second coordinate equals 20.
automaton.rule: SI(EQ(COMPTER(G0), 1), SUPEQ(COMPTER(G26*), 13), OU(OU(EQ(COMPTER(G26*), 13), EQ(COMPTER(G26*), 14)), ET(SUPEQ(COMPTER(G26*), 17), SUPEQ(19, COMPTER(G26*)))))
